perks.name: Second Thoughts
descriptions: One more free reroll every run.
Two more free rerolls every run.
Three more free rerolls every run.

perks.name: Banish
descriptions: Once a run, banish a card: it never comes up again that run, and the hand is dealt again.
Twice a run, banish a card.
Three times a run, banish a card.

perks.name: Skip
descriptions: Pass on any hand and take some gold instead.

perks.name: Opening Hand
descriptions: Your first level-up of every run deals four cards.

perks.name: Veteran's Lessons
descriptions: A class with less talent experience than your best earns 20% more.
A class with less talent experience than your best earns 40% more.

perks.name: Keen Eye
descriptions: Bosses are 5% more likely to drop each piece.
Bosses are 10% more likely to drop each piece.

perks.name: Companion
descriptions: A companion follows you through every run and sweeps up the coins and experience wisps up to 25 yd beyond your pickup radius: all within a pickup radius of its own, a quarter of yours, resting 2 sec between trips. Never a magnet or a cache.

perks.name: Long Leash
descriptions: Your companions fetch up to 35 yd beyond your pickup radius.
Your companions fetch up to 45 yd beyond your pickup radius.
Your companions fetch up to 55 yd beyond your pickup radius.

perks.name: Quick Paws
descriptions: Your companions run 20% faster and rest 1.6 sec between trips.
Your companions run 40% faster and rest 1.3 sec between trips.
Your companions run 60% faster and rest 1 sec between trips.

perks.name: Gold-sniffer
descriptions: An instinct: a companion goes for coins first, and the coins it fetches are worth 10% more. One instinct for each companion.

perks.name: Wisp-herder
descriptions: An instinct: a companion goes for experience wisps first, and takes them from twice as far. One instinct for each companion.

perks.name: Rune-hound
descriptions: An instinct: a companion also fetches battleground runes, those first. One instinct for each companion.

perks.name: Second Companion
descriptions: A second companion runs with the first, with an instinct of its own.
